decisions.reason: As a still-listed 2023 launch in a core handle category, it likely has enough strategic fit and low carrying cost within the firm's coordinated portfolio to keep the option open while market adoption continues to clarify.

Its upgrade from a mention to a dedicated page in 2024 signals growing commitment and positive information, so the firm would likely retain it as a promising option aligned with multifunctional and accessibility-oriented solutions.

Although it remains only mentioned rather than strongly promoted, it is still on the market in a category with long specification cycles, so management would probably keep it unless clearer evidence of weak demand emerges.
A dedicated page across both years plus major design awards strongly indicate realized value and brand-enhancing potential, making withdrawal within the next year very unlikely.
